credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: A collection of various round, smooth and flat rocks and stones displayed on a green ceramic plate. The rocks and stones vary in size from  4 1/4 inches in diameter to 1/2 inch in diameter and range in color from black, brown, gray and purple-red . One of the rocks is a sandstone concretion - a rock nestled in a hollowed out rock ( like an egg in a bird nest).
title: Rocks, Plate of Stones and Rocks
